prompt: Explain how transformers in machine learning work like I'm 7
response: Imagine you have a big box of colorful building blocks. Each block has a letter on it. Transformers help you build sentences by looking at all the blocks together, not just one at a time. They remember which blocks are near each other and use that to decide which blocks to put together next. This helps them understand the story better, just like how you understand a story better when you read it all at once instead of one word at a time.
